scope: Actual production bundle VM/DOM harness: canonical single-scene append, shared guarded history transaction, normalization, failure rollback, stale/reentrant refusal, preserved unrelated authoring/playback/cache state, Undo/Redo and save/reopen. Not browser acceptance.

results.name: Append selects one normalized canonical scene while retaining existing stores, caches, playback and tracker state
Append without selection leaves all current scene mirrors and unrelated settings intact
Scene normalization is authoritative only for the appended scene and never reloads unrelated authored records
Append Undo/Redo and save/reopen reproduce exactly the committed canonical project and original metadata
Scene identity, duplicate, capacity, selection and malformed scene validation failures are atomic
Stale and missing guards, paused history and unwritable state refuse scene import without mutation
Snapshot refusal or post-record failure restores history, dirty flag and references without appending
Failure after appending and partial mirror assignment rolls back canonical scene, descriptors and exact history
Scene and settings edits share the same reentrancy guard and release it after failure
A project edit during detached preparation is retained while stale append is rejected
Notification, selection-cache and refresh faults report committed warnings with complete editable scene mirrors
